Product Features

  • Minimalist geometric design: 119.7 x 49.8 x 35.5 cm oval tabletop + vertical square legs, creating a minimalist, industrial-style silhouette. Placed in front of the sofa, it instantly enhances the sophisticated ambiance of the living room.
  • Safety tips regarding load capacity: The average load capacity can reach 30 kg, but if the load on one side exceeds 10 kg, it can easily tip over. Clearly define the usage limits to feel safer when placing heavy items (e.g., by placing a coffee maker in the middle and light books on either side).
  • MDF + spray coating process: High-density MDF material is spray coated, the surface is smooth and wear-resistant, coffee stains and fingerprints can be easily wiped away, and daily maintenance is carried out without pressure.
  • Double leg construction: Two vertical, square legs distribute the pressure of the desktop, and the felt pad on the bottom is non-slip and protects the floor without scratching the floor when pulling.
  • Large storage area: 119.7 cm long oval tabletop, provides space for tea service, books and decorative ornaments simultaneously, meets the storage needs of a living room with several people and can neatly store cups and snacks at parties.
  • Style adaptability: The matte black finish is suitable for living rooms in modern, wabi-sabi, and industrial styles. It integrates perfectly with leather and fabric sofas and can be used to create a versatile ambiance.
  • Details of the felt glides: 4 felt glides on the underside, noiseless movement + scratch-resistant base, pulling the coffee table when cleaning does not disturb others and also protects the wooden/carpeted floors in the house.
  • Safe usage scenarios: Place the items evenly (e.g., a 20 kg aquarium in the middle and 5 kg books on each side), follow the principle of ≤ 10 kg on one side, and say goodbye to worrying that the items will “turn over as soon as you place them”.
  • Spaciousness for small apartments: The low height of 35.5cm + the transparent base construction make the living space appear brighter and the small apartment does not feel oppressive, but rather expands the sense of space.
